title: Photosynthetic Pigments and Light-Harvesting Complexes
word_count_method: Whitespace-separated tokens of saved p.teaching-prose text only, no headings, questions, tables, captions, glossary or revision.

scope.official: Revised 2026 CSIR–UGC–DBT Unit 6.A printed p.7; separate CSIR Life Sciences syllabus; MP SET 2024 Life Sciences Unit 6.A via mirrored PDF
scope.boundaries: PSII reaction chemistry reserved for 6.A.02, PSI chain for 6.A.03, detailed photoprotection for 6.A.05, photoreception for 6.E.

coverage_matrix.A: Light, photons, absorption and biological necessity

coverage_matrix.C: Chlorophyll a/b, Mg tetrapyrrole, phytol, carotenoids, pigment-protein structure
coverage_matrix.D: Absorption, relaxation, resonance transfer, trapping and charge separation
coverage_matrix.E: Photon energy, spectral overlap, Förster relation and energetics
coverage_matrix.F: State transitions, excitation balance, photoprotection at introductory scope
coverage_matrix.G: Energy, absorption, lifetime, FRET efficiency and quantum yield computations
coverage_matrix.H: Action spectra, oxygen evolution, fluorescence and controls
coverage_matrix.J: Antenna diversity, shade/sun acclimation and evolutionary context
coverage_matrix.K: Loss of antenna pigments, assembly and perturbation reasoning
coverage_matrix.L: Green light use, spectral overlap, fluorescence limits
coverage_matrix.M: Agricultural light management and chlorophyll fluorescence
coverage_matrix.N: Chloroplast prerequisite and PSII next node
coverage_matrix.O: 52 explained original exam questions and experimental interpretation

review_pass_1.findings: Verified assigned roadmap against official CSIR documents and MP SET mirror; distinguished energy transfer from net electron transport, absorption/action spectra, pigment solvent effects, PSI/PSII antenna organization, Förster assumptions, state transitions and fluorescence interpretation. Reviewed references and corrected schematic distinctions; numerical examples independently recomputed.
